title: Fuel-Composition
summary: A small Python script that reads a mustard oil composition CSV and generates synthetic tabular data from it. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) fitted on the dataset to produce synthetic samples.
